home.practice_freefall_blurb: Drop cargo pods down a shaft of rockers into the berths below. Set pods up in cradles, tip them down together, and leave your rival nothing.
freefall.title: Freefall
freefall.how_to: Tap one of the top lanes to drop a pod. The shaft widens as it falls. A pod rests in an empty cradle; onto a full cradle it rolls to the arm, and a pod past an arm flips the rocker, tipping out whatever lay in its cradle. Pods that meet in a lane fuse and fall as one, and a cluster of n pays its berth n times n. Whatever your drop brings down is yours.
freefall.how_to_keyboard: Left and right, or A and D, pick one of the top lanes. Space or enter drops.
freefall.legs_note: Five legs, each with its own berth values. The first side to its quota ends the leg, and the other side drops once more.
freefall.rival_note: Your rival drops after you, down whatever lane pays it most. Every pod you leave in a cradle is one it can tip.
freefall.stage.solo_intro: Drop pods down the shaft. Tip the full cradles together so they land as one cluster.
freefall.stage.full_intro: A rival drops after you. Take what pays, and leave it nothing to tip.
freefall.hint_note: Practice rounds show a drop worth making when you pause.
freefall.legend_pod: Cargo pod. Rests in an empty cradle, and falls with whatever it meets.
freefall.legend_cluster: A cluster: pods fused in one lane, their count on the pod. Pays its berth n times n.
freefall.legend_cradle: Cradle side of a rocker. Holds one pod.
freefall.legend_arm: Arm side of a rocker. A pod past it flips the rocker; an odd number of flips tips out the pod in the cradle.
freefall.legend_bay: Berths at the foot of the shaft. Their values change each leg.
studio.preset.freefall_sharp_rival: A sharp rival: always takes the most
studio.preset.freefall_linear: Linear clusters: n pods pay n times
studio.preset.freefall_deep_shaft: A deep shaft: ten lanes in, twenty berths, ten rows
studio.preset.freefall_open_shaft: An open shaft: a third of rockers missing
studio.preset.freefall_straight_shaft: A straight shaft: every lane takes a drop
